children: South African state power utility Eskom's board chairman, Mteto Nyati, will continue in his role for another three years after the cabinet approved his reappointment, Electricity Minister Kgosientsho Ramokgopa said on Friday.
Nyati, who was appointed in 2023, had been due to step down at the end of October when his current term expires.
